scene.ko: 친구 집들이에서 처음 만난 사람과 이름과 하는 일을 주고받는다.

lines.en: Hi, I'm Emma. Nice to meet you.
Hi, Emma. I'm Jiwon. Nice to meet you, too.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 엠마 씨. 저는 지원이에요. 저도 반가워요.
alt: Hi, I'm Jiwon. Nice to meet you.
Hello, Emma. My name is Jiwon.

lines.en: So, what do you do, Jiwon?
lines.ko: 그럼 지원 씨는 무슨 일 하세요?

lines.en: I'm a nurse. I work at a hospital.
alt: I work at a hospital. I'm a nurse.
I'm a nurse at a hospital.

lines.en: Oh, wow. That must be a tough job.
It is, but I like it. What about you?
alt: Yes, but I love it. And you?
It is busy, but I like it. How about you?

lines.en: I'm a graphic designer. I work from home.

expressions.note: 직업 앞에 a · an 을 붙임
같은 질문을 되돌려 물을 때 · How about you? 도 같음
